opening.argument: The speaker does more than reject the accusation: he calls Forsage a “lifetime business platform” and dismisses criticism as “talking nonsense,” urging viewers not to credit warnings. The displayed account preview pairs 3,782.3 BUSD in profits with 57 partners and a team of 772, while another page shows an inviter relationship and a personal Forsage link. The programs also present x4 and xGold tiers with BUSD upgrade prices. Taken together, these are not simply claims about a business in the abstract: the pages connect profit metrics to partner and team counts, invitations, and paid upgrades, supporting the conclusion that participation is promoted through a recruitment-dependent earning structure. The evidence establishes that presentation; it does not establish actual losses or outcomes.
